note: Adjudications for ticker matches whose Coinbase currency name does not normalise to the CMC slug. Same-project judgments rest on the agent's knowledge of public rebrandings and token migrations (CLAIMED, not independently verified here); they are flagged for the independent reviewer. Different-project ticker collisions are set to unknown, the conservative default. v2 (2026-10-19, before any listing dates fetched or returns computed) adds alternate-ticker adjudications after a name-based check found CMC coins listed on Coinbase under a different ticker; v1 file and v1 map are preserved. v3 (2026-10-19, before any listing dates fetched or returns computed): the builder's candidate check now also runs when the CMC ticker exists on Coinbase under a different project, and also matches a whole name against the slug's first word and a ticker embedded in a longer Coinbase ticker. New candidates are adjudicated here; three v2 decisions are corrected (29210 JUP -> JUPITER by contract evidence in the saved currency record; 39720 EDGE -> EDGEX; 39125 LIT -> LIGHTER). Judgments remain CLAIMED (agent knowledge plus saved Coinbase records) pending independent review. Final v3 additions (2026-10-19, after CMC contract data were saved and before any Coinbase listing dates were fetched): operator-approved continuation for 5690 (RNDR -> RENDER, both contracts listed by CMC); contract overrides with stated evidence for three legacy-contract cases (1455 GNT, 7080 GALA V1, 1982 legacy KNC). Not applied: MATIC -> POL (CMC 3890 does not list the POL contract; POL is its own CMC ID 28321), YFII -> YFI (different project), GNT -> GLM continuation (CMC does not list the GNT contract).
